words.ar: حد أو حاجة ليها قيمة كبيرة للشركة
words.def: a person or thing that is very useful and valuable to a team or company.
words.book: I'm confident I will be a valuable asset to your team.
uses: Email
Ahmed's experience with lithium batteries makes him a real asset to the service team.
Chat
honestly Mona is a huge asset on the solar projects 💪
Meeting
Our maintenance contracts are our most valuable asset — they bring steady income.
goes: a real asset to the team
dont: I will be a very important thing for your team.
doo: I will be a valuable asset to your team.

words.def: to decide which tasks are most important and do them first.
words.book: After working part-time as a ___, I learned how to multitask and prioritize responsibilities.
uses: Email
We will prioritize the hospital's UPS failure and schedule the other visits for Thursday.
Chat
too many tickets today — which one do we prioritize?
Meeting
Let's prioritize customers with expired maintenance contracts this week.
dont: I put the important things first before the not important.
doo: I prioritize the most urgent tasks.

words.def: unhappy and annoyed, usually because of bad service or unfair treatment.
words.book: At my internship over the summer, I was working the support line and received a call from a disgruntled customer who had been dropped from our service.
uses: Email
We received a complaint from a disgruntled customer about the delayed battery replacement.
Chat
got a disgruntled client on the line, can you join? 😬
Meeting
How do we handle disgruntled customers when spare parts are late?
dont: The customer was very angry and not happy from us.
doo: The customer was disgruntled with our service.

words.def: to deal quickly with an urgent problem at work (not a real fire).
words.book: In both personal and professional interactions, I think it's important to always approach things with a positive mindset — whether it's getting a positive response from a difficult client or putting out a fire in a chaotic situation.
uses: Email
Apologies for the late reply — I spent the morning putting out fires at the data centre site.
Chat
sorry, putting out a fire with the inverter at the factory 🔥 call you later
Meeting
I don't want us to spend every week putting out fires — we need preventive maintenance.
goes: spend the day putting out fires
dont: I was extinguishing problems all day.
doo: I was putting out fires all day.

words.def: to finish work by the date or time that was agreed.
words.book: I'm also committed to meeting deadlines and completing all tasks to high standards.
uses: Email
To meet the tender deadline, please send the final quotation by Wednesday noon.
Chat
we're tight on time but we'll meet the deadline 👍
Meeting
If the batteries arrive late, we won't meet the installation deadline.

words.def: to delay doing something, often because you don't want to do it.
words.book: Crossing things off my to-do list makes me feel accomplished, and I've learned to tackle harder tasks early in the day, when I'm refreshed and less likely to put them off.
uses: Email
We can't put off the battery replacement any longer — the site had two outages last month.
Chat
stop putting off the collections calls 😅
Meeting
The customer keeps putting off the payment, so let's escalate it.
dont: I make it later and later.

upgrade.plain: I am a person who learns fast.
pro: I am a fast-learning person very much.
upgrade.why: ‎pick things up quickly‎ أطبع من الترجمة الحرفية، و‎fastly‎ غلط.

upgrade.plain: I don't have experience, but I will learn.
pro: I don't have any experience, sorry.
I'm without experience but I learn.
While I'm still building my experience, I'm a quick learner and eager to grow.
upgrade.why: ماتبدأش بالنقص؛ قول ‎while I'm still building…‎ وبعدها ميزتك.

upgrade.plain: I can't say no to anyone.
pro: I've learned that it's OK to say no when my plate is full.
I say yes always to everyone.
upgrade.why: في المقابلة اذكر العيب ومعاه اللي اتعلمته: ‎I've learned…‎.

upgrade.plain: I am perfect in my work.
pro: I tend to be a perfectionist, so I've learned to balance quality with deadlines.
upgrade.why: ‎perfectionist‎ هي الكلمة، و‎tend to‎ تخليها أهدى.

upgrade.plain: I respect the rules of the company.
pro: I always play by the rules and follow company guidelines.
I am obeying all rules of the company.
upgrade.why: التعبير الجاهز ‎play by the rules‎ + ‎company guidelines‎.

upgrade.plain: I solve the problems of the customers when they are angry.
upgrade.ar: بحل مشاكل العملاء لما يكونوا متعصبين
pro: I make the angry customer cool.
I'm good at calming down upset customers and finding solutions.
upgrade.why: ‎calm down upset customers‎ أدق ومهني أكتر من ‎angry‎.
